name: chief-of-staff-board
description: A side pane for a coordinator session: what is waiting on you, ready for review, in flight and handled, drawn from a JSON file your coordinator agent keeps current

boardFile.title: Board file
boardFile.description: Path of the board JSON file. Empty: board.json in the folder the session starts in. ~/ is your home folder

slackTeamId.title: Slack team id
slackTeamId.description: Your Slack workspace id (starts with T). When set, Slack links open in the Slack app at the thread instead of the browser

pollSeconds.title: Re-read every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the pane re-reads the board file
